calls.summary: New dad, two months in; sleep-deprived but happy. Talked about the baby's name.

turns.text: Our daughter is two months old now. We named her Mira.
Congratulations, Vikram! Mira is a lovely name.

calls.summary: Corrected the spelling of his daughter's name (Myra). Work is stressful because of layoff rumours; he asked not to discuss work for a while.

turns.text: Small thing: it's Myra with a y, not Mira.
Got it, Myra with a y. Thanks for telling me.
And please don't ask about work for a bit, there are layoff rumours and I don't want to think about it at night.

memories.text: His daughter's name is Myra, spelled with a y

Worried about layoff rumours at work
